maddeler.e:
استفسروا (form X)
# اِسْتَفْسَرُوا (istafsarū) /is.taf.sa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَفْسَرَ (istafsara)
# اُسْتُفْسِرُوا (ustufsirū) /us.tuf.si.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَفْسَرَ (istafsara)
# اِسْتَفْسِرُوا (istafsirū) /is.taf.si.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَفْسَرَ (istafsara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
